title: Welcome to your daily briefing
script: Good morning! Welcome to your very first daily briefing. Here's how this works: every night, an agent puts together a short update like this one, tailored to your level, so you can get some listening practice on your commute. Each briefing comes with a few expressions worth stealing — they'll be highlighted in the script, and they'll show up in your review deck later the same day. Try to catch them by ear first, then check the script to see how close you were. If the pace feels off, you can slow it down or speed it up anytime. That's it for today — from tomorrow, we'll dive into real tech news. Have a good one!
